name: Twenty
description: Open-source CRM: contacts, companies, deals and pipelines with a customizable data model, with a private PostgreSQL database, Redis and a preconfigured administrator.

configFields.label: Application secret
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Signs sessions and tokens shared by the server and the worker; changing it logs everyone out.

fields.label: Admin email
fields.help: Used to sign in. Manage members in the app.

prepare.title: Create the administrator
prepare.description: Signs the administrator up through Twenty's own API, creates and activates the workspace, then stores the generated 64-character password (Twenty only accepts up to 50 characters at sign-up, so the first sign-up uses its first 50).

connection.title: Sign in to Twenty
connection.description: Sign in with the email and generated password below. The account and workspace are created on first start, so no confirmation email is needed.

firstLogin.note: Account changes made in the app (a password change, new members) are preserved on redeployment. The first sign-in asks for your name and walks you through onboarding. Outgoing email is not configured, so invitation and password-reset emails are not sent; add SMTP through the EMAIL_* variables. The first start runs database migrations, so allow a few minutes.

features.title: Contacts, companies and deals
features.description: A customizable CRM data model with pipelines, tasks, notes and views.

features.title: Private database
features.description: Your data lives in a dedicated, project-scoped PostgreSQL instance, with Redis for queues and caching.

features.title: Background jobs included
features.description: A worker service runs queued and scheduled jobs alongside the server.
